title: Epileptic spikes detector in pediatric EEG based on matched filters and neural networks
summary: A matched-filter detector followed by neural-network confirmation identified epileptic spikes in pediatric EEG; the study reported sensitivity 99.96% and specificity 99.26%. The result is limited to the evaluated recordings and does not establish improved clinical outcomes.
ai_technology: A matched-filter detector identifies candidate pediatric EEG spikes, then a neural network confirms them.
